items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring), listed questionable, is active and expected to play vs. Ravens. Confirmed on inactive report.
items.why: Schefter expected-to-play AM report followed by active confirmation; Levitan notes clean, no docks.
items.implication: WR1 start; Saints high-volume passing script intact.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; no real limitation projected.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow, listed as questionable (back), is officially active vs. the Texans. Rapoport confirmed he will play and is active.
items.why: Official inactive list and Schefter/Rapoport confirmation after expected-to-play reports.
items.implication: Burrow is a locked-in fantasy QB1 start; no backup elevation impact.
items.opportunity: Full snap expectation; elevates Chase/Higgins/Brown usage certainty.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) downgraded to OUT. Opens door for Bateman and elevates TE usage.
items.why: Saturday downgrade confirmed on inactives; ETR/Schefter align.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; target share redistributes.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WRs and Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) downgraded to OUT. ETR/Levitan flag Germie Bernard for increased look.
items.implication: Sit Pittman; pivot to other Steelers pass-catchers or streamers.
items.opportunity: Slot/YAC role expansion for backups; Berry/Levitan like Bernard fit.

items.text: Dolphins QB Tua Tagovailoa inactive. Confirmed on Schefter list alongside other early inactives.
items.implication: Dolphins offense downgraded; impacts Waddle/Achane script.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) in with decent injury docks. Rapoport bullish/optimism he plays (flak jacket); status likely until ~2:30pm ET inactives. True GTD but trending positive.
items.why: Practiced Friday, team did not elevate WR, Rap tone bullish, Schefter flak jacket note; Levitan docks for limitation risk.
items.implication: Start if active as WR2/flex but have pivot ready; partial snaps possible.
items.opportunity: If out/limited, Quentin Johnston role expands significantly.
items.conflict: Docks vs full-target expectation if fully cleared.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) is a true game-time decision for MNF vs Giants. Rams consider it pre-game decision; no practice Saturday.
items.why: Schefter: pre-game decision; ETR lists GTD; different injury from camp psoas.
items.implication: Hold/start with pivot ready for MNF; high variance.
items.opportunity: If out, heavier TE usage and bump to secondary WRs (Mumpfield noted by Berry).

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) unlikely to play vs Jaguars. ETR: not expected; Levitan expects decent look at Jonah Coleman.
items.why: Schefter source unlikely; ETR summary not expected.
items.implication: Sit Harvey; monitor Broncos backfield shares.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/routes for backup RBs (Coleman look per Levitan).

items.text: Bucs WR Jalen McMillan (knee) expected to play but not full-time role/snap count yet. Active confirmation.
items.why: Schefter source: expected but not full-time; ETR snap count note; active list.
items.implication: Flex risk; monitor actual snaps. Egbuka/Godwin more secure volume.
items.opportunity: If limited, boost to other Bucs WRs.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee) doubtful; elevated Myarick. Could return next week. Mayer saw volume in absence.
items.why: Saturday elevation and reports; Rap notes possible next-week return.
items.implication: Sit Bowers; start Mayer or stream TE if needed.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated targets/routes as primary TE.

items.text: Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snaps, 40% target rate on routes (tied team lead) in Wk1; IND gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. Elite utilization.
items.why: Heavy early-down + receiving usage; soft run matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; upside to finish as overall RB1.

items.text: Loves Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score (tied Bijan lead) Wk1; 19% target share recent; high touch volume.
items.why: Elite utilization and passing-game involvement vs amenable Chargers D.

items.text: Loves Bucky Irving vs CLE: 26% target share, all RB red-zone touches Wk1; CLE soft vs run; out-routed Gainwell.
Loves Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Wk1; career 93 yds/18 PPG with Wentz; Bears D soft vs WRs recently.
items.why: Volume with Wentz + favorable matchup (weather noted separately by others).
items.conflict: Weather (rain) could suppress overall passing somewhat per Fitz.

items.text: Loves Dak Prescott vs WAS: smash spot, home, high implied total (27), WAS torched for 14.5 YPC and 3 pass TDs Wk1.
items.why: Game script and matchup scream pass volume/TDs.
items.opportunity: High pass attempts and scoring environment.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne @ BAL: Wk1 usage concerning (matched Miller rushes, air-dependent); Kamara expected back squeezes role further; tough script as underdogs.
items.why: Committee risk with Kamara return + poor early-down share.
items.implication: Sit or heavy fade; volatile RB3/flex at best.
items.opportunity: Kamara reclaims passing downs; Miller early work.

items.text: Hates Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: only 8% target share Wk1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks; SEA tough vs WRs.
Loves Dalton Kincaid (high route rate, DET soft vs TEs), Mike Evans (MIA soft secondary, RZ share), DeVonta Smith (27% share, TEN soft vs WRs).
